messages:
Alex: AM standup — did: bumped AMS1 pool +4 GPUs (p3dn), validated canary for quantized-ggml branch, ran a short latency sweep. blocker: quota increase 42->46 still pending with cloud; ticket #4567 needs business justification. today: monitor queue depth, follow up with infra-requests, run small DR drill at 16:00 UTC. @Nisha can you eyeball AZ spread and confirm no single-A hotspot?

Nisha: saw the ticket, I pinged the cloud rep and linked our usage report. they asked for a short justification — I'll draft it. noticed 2 spot evictions in AMS1 overnight, recommend reserving 2 on-demand for peak window. current AZ map AMS1 = {a:3, b:2, c:1} total6 — moving one from a->c would reduce risk.

Tyler: left a CR on autoscaler scaling-window (small change: keep warm nodes 5m instead of 1m). link: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/autoscaler/PR/812 — should reduce churning but affects cost slightly. Q: will that increase tail latency for short requests?

Alex: good catch. it might add a couple ms for first-token on very short sessions, but reduces pod churn. seems acceptable for dedicated pools; hold for canary.

Jamie: prewarm plan in prod: rolling job starts 15:50 UTC, warm TTL 30m. I'll watch logs and ramp policy. if queue depth > 80% for 2 consecutive minutes we pause ramp and alert. can someone confirm the warm-image tag used for the run?

Tyler: warm-image = infra/warm:2026-03-10-rc2. kernels updated to select avx512 path by default for that tag. have unit tests but not full canary yet.

sre-bot: [alert] spot-eviction spike detected in AMS1 between 03:00-05:00 UTC (2 events). Auto-fallback to on-demand succeeded for 3 affected jobs, no user-facing errors.

Nisha: noted. I'll update the ticket justification with last 7-day eviction summary and propose keeping 2 on-demand reservations between 14:00-20:00 UTC for next 3 days.

Alex: decision: hold kernel-select config rollout until the DR run completes at ~16:30 UTC. if green, we roll to 10% canary for 1h, then evaluate. Tyler please coordinate CR merge timing with Jamie so prewarm uses correct image.

Jamie: ack. I'll tag the warm job to use the RC2 image after the DR run passes. will post logs in this thread if anything pops. :thumbsup:

Tyler: quick follow-up — does the new autoscaler window require updating our cost dashboard thresholds? if so I can add a small PR to the dashboard config.

Alex: yes, please bump the churn metric threshold by +10% for the next 24h so we don't get noisy alerts. file a tiny PR and tag me.

Jamie: leaving a watch on the rolling job. if queue backs up or evictions recur, manual failover plan is to move 1 GPU from AMS2 pool into AMS1 for 30m.

Alex: added a summary note to ticket #4567 with today's plan and owners. thanks team. leaving async — will check back after the 16:00 DR run.
